mapper.select: SELECT ksva.kg_id `kgId`, ksva.id `id`, ksva.type `vacateType`, ksva.begin_time `beginTime`, ksva.end_time `endTime`, ksva.STATUS `status`, ksva.create_time `applyTime`, ks.`name` `studentName`, kc.class_name, ks.birthdate, ksva.reason, ml.phone `applyPhone`, ksva.approve_by, ksva.approve_time, ksva.approve_opinion, ksva.student_id FROM kg_student_vacate_apply ksva LEFT JOIN kg_student ks ON ksva.student_id = ks.id LEFT JOIN kg_classroom kc ON kc.id = ks.class_id LEFT JOIN mini_login ml ON ksva.apply_by = ml.id WHERE ksva.del_flag = 0 AND ks.del_flag = 0 AND ksva.id = #{id}

SELECT ksva.id `id`, ksva.type `vacateType`, ksva.begin_time `beginTime`, ksva.end_time `endTime`, ksva.STATUS `status`, ks.`name` `studentName`, kc.class_name, ml.phone, ksva.student_id FROM kg_student_vacate_apply ksva LEFT JOIN kg_student ks ON ksva.student_id = ks.id LEFT JOIN kg_classroom kc ON kc.id = ks.class_id LEFT JOIN mini_login ml ON ksva.apply_by = ml.id WHERE ksva.del_flag = 0 AND ks.del_flag = 0 AND ksva.kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND ksva.status != 0
AND kc.id = #{queryVO.classroomId}
AND ks.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryVO.studentName}, '%')
ORDER BY ksva.id DESC

SELECT ksva.id, ksva.apply_time, ks.`name` `applyName`, kc.class_name, '申请休假' 'describe' FROM kg_student_vacate_apply ksva LEFT JOIN kg_student ks ON ksva.student_id = ks.id LEFT JOIN kg_classroom kc ON ks.class_id = kc.id WHERE ksva.kg_id = #{kgId} AND ksva.`status` = 0 ORDER BY ksva.id DESC

SELECT apply_by, apply_time, approve_by, approve_opinion, approve_time, begin_time, bloc_id, class_id, create_by, create_time, del_flag, end_time, id, kg_id, reason, STATUS, student_id, type, update_by, update_time FROM kg_student_vacate_apply ksva WHERE ksva.del_flag = 0 AND ksva.kg_id = #{kgId} AND (DATE_FORMAT( ksva.begin_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) <= #{date} AND DATE_FORMAT( ksva.end_time, '%Y-%m-%d' ) >= #{date} )
